swamp_witch_20.m: Who dares disturb my solitude? Be gone, or face my wrath!
r: Sorry. I got lost in the fog.
I am not afraid of you. (You grope for your weapon)

swamp_witch_20_10.m: Oh, how touching. The brave little hero got themselves lost, did they?

swamp_witch_20_100.m: Loneliness is a price I'm willing to pay for my solitude.

swamp_witch_20_102.m: People fear me because of my powers, and I grow weary of their endless superstitions and suspicions. Here, far from any village, I can be myself without interference.

swamp_witch_20_104.m: Here I have found peace at last.
r: I'm sorry people treat you that way. But maybe if they got to know you, they wouldn't be so afraid.

swamp_witch_20_110.m: Bah! Humans will always fear what they don't understand.
r: Maybe you are right. Let me think ...
Right. And now you should fear me - attack!

swamp_witch_20_12.m: And now you expect me to help you? Ha!
r: No. I can handle myself as always.
I managed to defeat the fog monsters that caused it.

swamp_witch_20_120.m: Hmph, fine. But be quick about it.
r: Shrink the fog in the north.
People have trouble that the way to Feygard goes through your fog. If you make your fog a little smaller in the north, nobody will bother you anymore.

swamp_witch_20_134.m: Agreed. Here child, take these sweets and now begone!
r: [grumbling] Sweets - I am no kid anymore.
People have trouble that the way to Feygard is barred by your fog. No fog on the road, no reason to visit you.
And being a witch, you can certainly put a spell around your swamp that will distract people from wanting to come here.

swamp_witch_20_144.m: Swamp! what did you name my beautiful peace of land??

swamp_witch_20_150.m: A distraction spell. That I didn't think of it myself ...

swamp_witch_20_160.m: Great. You deserve a reward for that. You may choose one thing from these:
r: A vial of healing water from the garden

swamp_witch_20_170.m: Here take this stuff. And now go and finally leave me alone.

swamp_witch_20_180.m: Well, choose what you want. Of course you'll have to pay for it.

swamp_witch_20_190.m: You have it. And now go and finally leave me alone. Otherwise I'll turn you into a frog. [Muttering] Here, take this bottle.

swamp_witch_20_20.m: Defeated my fog monsters, did you? Meddlesome brat!

swamp_witch_20_200.m: [Grinning wickedly] I think it's time you learn a lesson, meddling child.
r: What are you going to do?

swamp_witch_20_210.m: The old witch raises her hands, chanting ominously.

swamp_witch_20_212.m: A curse upon you, little one! May darkness be your companion, and fear be your guide!
r: I won't let you curse me! (Draws the weapon)
I'm sorry, ma'am. Please forgive me.
Wait! Spare me please. I'll give you ...

swamp_witch_20_214.m: Hahaha! You? Defeat me? We shall see!

swamp_witch_20_22.m: Those creatures were my only protection from unwanted visitors like you!
r: I didn't know. The fog was disorienting ...
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you.
Not much of a protection, were they.

swamp_witch_20_220.m: Oh, the heroic little braveheart, off to save their own skin.

r: My Ring of the Lesser Shadow
My Ring of the Lesser Shadow

swamp_witch_20_228.m: I have no need for that. But I will take it nevertheless.

swamp_witch_20_228b.m: You don't even have this ring. Don't show off like that!

r: And I just wanted to find my way to Feygard.
I just want to find my way home.

swamp_witch_20_30.m: [Grumbles] Lost, you say? It's your own fault for wandering where you don't belong. I prefer to be left alone, away from the meddling of outsiders.
r: I understand, and I'm really sorry. I promise I'll leave as soon as you point me in the right direction.

swamp_witch_20_40.m: [Grinning wickedly] That is easy. Go outside and far away. As fast as possible.

r: ... despite what I have always heard about witches in the swamp.

swamp_witch_20_50.m: [Gruffly] Kind? Bah! I simply don't want the likes of you lingering around here.

swamp_witch_20_60.m: Now, listen carefully, child. I will wait a few minutes before I create fog again.

swamp_witch_20_62.m: Be sure to be out of the area.
r: I appreciate your help. I promise I'll be away for good. But can I ask you something else before I leave?

swamp_witch_20_70.m: [Sighs] Make it quick, then. I don't have all night.
r: Why do you live all alone in this swamp? Don't you ever get lonely?

swamp_witch_20_80.m: Men used to laugh at me. They threw stones at me and finally tried to burn my house.

swamp_witch_20_82.m: All I want is peace and to enjoy my lovely garden outside.
r: Eh, yes, your garden is beautiful.

swamp_witch_20_90.m: Yes, it is. At least one person who knows beauty when they see it.

swamp_witch_20_92.m: Well, I shall spare you... this time. Now leave my sight and never return!
r: It was sort of nice to meet you.

swamp_witch_80.m: You again! You promised me peace and solitude!

swamp_witch_90.m: Oh - how did you pass through my distraction fence?

r: OK, sorry for disturbing your peace.
Can I buy more of your medicinal water?

swamp_witch_90_20.m: Well, if you promise to finally leave me alone afterwards.

fogmonster.5: You had entered a very unnatural looking fog and decided to find the source of it. Maybe you could lift the fog?
fogmonster.10: After you chased away a fog monster, the fog suddenly dissipated.
fogmonster.20: Another fog monster guarded the footbridge to the hut. As long as there was still fog somewhere around the hut, you couldn't drive it away.
fogmonster.30: In the hut you encountered a terrifying looking witch.
fogmonster.70: You defeated the old witch in battle, so she can't create a new fog.
fogmonster.80: You were able to convince the witch Mim to keep the road clear of fog.
fogmonster.90: You convinced the witch Mim to replace the fog with a distraction spell.
fogmonster.92: Madame Mim gave you a bottle of her swamp water.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
